question: What conduct should a practitioner adopt after gaining mental equanimity through practice?
premises: Repeated practice leads to mental equanimity.
Conventional village dharma represents ordinary social obligation.
The text prescribes abandonment of that conventional dharma.
inference: One whose mind has become even through practice should abandon conventional village dharma.
uncertainties: grāma-dharma may refer broadly to worldly or communal duties.
plain_english: Through practice, when the mind becomes even, one should abandon the duties of ordinary village life.
